question: As of October 2020 which of the following enterprises is NOT classified as a Maharatna company?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NHPC**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of October 2020, **NHPC** (National Hydroelectric Power Corporation) is NOT classified as a Maharatna company.
 
• It is **an Indian public sector hydropower company that was incorporated in 1975 to pla**n
 
• It holds the status of a **Miniratna Category-I** company.
 
• The **Maharatna status** is granted to Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) that meet certain criteria, including high turnover, profitability, and global presence.
 
• This **status allows the enterprises greater autonomy in decision-making and investments, enhancing their operational flexibility.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** List of Maharatna's: 

 
• Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited.
 
• Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited.
 
• Coal India Limited.
 
• Gas Authority of India Limited.
 
• Hindusthan Petroleum Corporation Limited.
 
• Indian Oil Corporation Limited.
 
• National Thermal Corporation Limited.
 
• Oil and Natural Gas Corporation.
 
• Power Grid Corporation of India.
 
• Steel Authority of India Limited.
 
• Power Finance Corporation Limited.
